lines.t: One light, one truth, the only fountain
Some were shown a glimpse while others walked in shame
Truth arrives in measure and not all see the same
What is clear to one may still be veiled to many more
So trust comes first, then understanding opens doors
When the mind turns back, the light begins to fade
But the heart that keeps us faith will never walk astray
Keep him in the front through every season, every hour
And peace will rise like morning from the hidden spring of power
Abide, and the darkness breaks
Stay near, and the waiting waits
All things rest where His wisdom flows
In His will, the river goes
He is the only fountain
The only knowledge that gives life
The more we seek his kingdom
The more the truth shines bright
First his reign, first his ways
Then revelation comes to stay
In his understanding we are hell
And that is enough today
When the kingdom comes before the roots for self and pride
He pours out what was hidden and the soul is satisfied
Grace adds light to light
And the spirit learns to see what was once a distant spark
Becomes a living mystery
Not by force, not by sight
But by the gift of holy seeing, every answer grows in him
Every season finds its meaning in the one who stays near him
In the quiet and the storm finds a deeper peace
The knowledge ever could perform
But by, and the darkness breaks
Stay near, and the waiting waits
All things rest where his wisdom flows
In his will, the river goes
He is the only fountain, the only knowledge that gives life
The more we seek his kingdom, the more the truth shines bright
First his reign, first his ways, then revelation comes to stay
In his understanding we are held
And that is enough today
day seek first the kingdom let the rest unfold more is given to the humble heart than silver
more than gold poured out by the spirit revelation fills the air what was dim becomes a fire
For the ones who wait in prayer
He is the only fountain
The only knowledge that gives life
The more we seek his kingdom
The more the truth shines bright
First His reign, first His ways
Then revelation comes to stay
In His understanding we are held
And that is enough today
The only fountain
The only knowledge
And in him, peace remains
